dataList.content: Магазин Сила России

Видишь ли, нужно нечто большее, чем череда неудач и пустой кошелек, чтобы человек добровольно переступил порог ломбарда. Люди куда более склонны мириться с жалкой, убогой суетой выживания, чем может показаться... До тех пор, пока их не покинет даже слабая надежда на завтрашний день.
Именно тогда они начинают стекаться в это мрачное место, готовые расстаться с самыми дорогими осколками своего прошлого.
На витрине лежит протез правой руки, украшенный рельефным узором, билет на поезд неизвестно куда и проржавевшая перьевая ручка, которая, похоже, все еще может чего-то стоить.
Ты неловко топчешься на месте, но владелец, очевидно, видел таких, как ты, тысячу раз. Даже не поднимая глаз, он спрашивает: «Ну, что у тебя там?»

Ты шаришь по карманам и...
Продать душу своей матери (у тебя её нет).
Продать свой туз (порванный)
Повернуться и сбежать нахуй.
Получение водительских прав

К тебе подходит группа людей, собравшихся в переулке.

"Знаешь, на завтрашнем практическом экзамене... скажем так, лица там проверяют не слишком тщательно."

Тебе не требуется много времени, чтобы понять, к чему они клонят.

"А мои дети еще совсем молоды. У них просто маловато опыта."

Кто-то рядом подхватывает мысль:

"Но мы слышали, что если они получат все сертификаты до конца этого месяца, то на собеседованиях в следующем им начислят дополнительные баллы..."

Никто так и не упоминает, что именно это за экзамен. И все же, возможно, такие люди, как ты, могли бы немного подсобить им на пути к заветной мечте - жизни в Гнезде?
Отправить одного Балбеса. Они не выглядят довольными, но кому не похуй.
Вытянуть жребий и отправить двух Балбесов. Это должно помочь им сдать экзамен на водительские права (нет).
Не помогать. Жизнь в Москва-сити никогда не будет лёгкой.
An Overcrowded Playground

A moving truck loaded with someone's belongings squeezes в the narrow alley. Every child in the playground turns to look, but what a shame—not a single face lights up in welcome.

"But the playground's already full. 8 on the red swings, 5 on the green ones, 10 on the slide, 4.5 on the steps, и 10 on the seesaw."

The child who seems to be in charge counts the kids off, each syllable crisp и clear.

"Where are we even supposed to put the new kid?"
On the sand. It's the only place left for a latecomer.
On the red swings. Maybe there's room to squeeze in just one more?
Stay out of the headcount. Turn my back on the children и walk away.
Counterfeit Business Card

"You could be anyone. Even someone you never dared to dream of being."

The owner runs through the pitch with the ease of someone who's heard больше чем a few hard-luck stories.
For все the grand promises, though, they're holding nothing больше чем a few business cards.

"On this little piece of paper, при least, you're a team leader при K Corp. Or the director of a Grade 5 Fixer Office, если you prefer. Mind you, если the inspectors come knocking, this is a fruit shop, и все you've bought today is a nice, ripe apple."

With one of those artfully forged cards in hand... you could be anyone.
Try being someone else. Anyone will do, so long as it isn't who I am now.
Become a new hire при a Wing. That should leave plenty of people green with envy.
Stick with who I am. This life isn't so bad, все things considered.
A Hill of Rags

Between the crowded market stalls, a hill rises в your view. You получает a closer look, soon realizing that it contains layers upon layers of clothing; perhaps the whole town's laundry есть found its way в the pile? It's their lives и experiences worn thin, creased, crumpled, filthy, reeking.

Maybe it wouldn't hurt для получения an outfit along, something to set aside for later. Our own clothes will find their way down to the foot of this hill one day...
Получает a suit. Another rinse и a good ironing might make it look presentable enough.
Получает the hide of... something. Wandering these streets, there may come a time когда looking human isn't such a good idea.
Получает nothing. What I'm wearing will do.
An Empty Bus Stop

You find yourself при a bus stop, not a soul to be seen.
A bus from nowhere pulls up in front of you; you have no idea where it's going.
As though returning the favor for все the time you've spent waiting, it waits patiently without so much as a honk.
But it won't wait for you forever.
Even after night есть fallen, the Backstreets have another night in store, after все...
You'd better decide how you're getting home, и quickly.
Get on the bus.
Head off on foot, following the way I remember.
Let the bus go и stay при the stop. But will there even be another one?
White Nights

You see a brilliant pillar of light shooting до the sky, its rays cutting through the gaps between the tightly packed buildings. Your whole world lights up, as though night itself есть ceased to exist.
One на one, the people of the Backstreets lift their heads toward the sky.
Beneath that gentle, warm light, you...
Look up при the sky with everyone else.
Look down при the light scattering across the uneven pavement.
Just squeeze my eyes shut.
A Wall Full of Rumors

From petty errands to expeditions и contract killings, there's never a shortage of work for a Fixer, is there?
The pay for each job looks fair enough. On paper, при least.
But which will you получает, и which will you turn a blind eye to? The choice is yours.
Urban Myth. Получает on the sort of job that's familiar enough.
Follow a Canard that might turn a profit.
Urban Legend. Получает on a job that offers a hefty payout.
Получает none of the contracts.
Familiar Yet Unknown Alleyways

The labyrinthine network of alleyways winds on, one turn after another. These Backstreets resemble every alley you can remember, yet somehow none of them feel familiar. You keep walking, turn after turn, but there's no end in sight. затем, все при один раз, a sudden realization comes to you: this odd feeling that's been tugging при your attention is...
The darkness closing in around me. Better получает out my PDA и check the time.

3:13 AM.
Когда the "Night" falls on the Backstreets, they come.
Come sunrise, there won't be a trace of anything left behind.
Music drifting from somewhere. It's got a catchy beat.

Clinking chains. Boisterous guffaw. Right, the Middle never forgets. один раз you're in their bad books, you'll be on the run for the rest of your life... only to inevitably find them waiting при the mouth of some alleyway.
The sound of something barking...
One starts barking, и soon every alley is barking in tandem. The four-legged things crawl on these streets, howling в the air without even figuring out what they are meant to guard.
Nothing worth stopping for. Keep walking.
I decide to keep moving. What I'm waiting for might not be in this alley при все.
Nothing that matters. I don't want to care about anything anymore.
Whatever it is, I have no desire to find out. Soon, those stirrings will die away. Then something else will come along to fill the silence.
Dark Cloud

You wander в the cul-de-sac of some labyrinthine network of alleyways.
This Backstreets you've stepped в is unlike any street you've walked before; it is при один раз unfamiliar и disinterested.
With nothing but your memories as drawing paper, you begin sketching the life in this Backstreets, caring little for what is true или false, what is weak или powerful...
As the disinterest of the streets turns в a specific, unwelcome interest, black clouds stretching from your thoughts cast shadows just as long и dark over the alleyway.
Cut through the cumulus.

Ten Blades of the East. Blade Fiend. Ashura.
Each warrior who held one of those titles есть brought me again и again before the gates of hell, searing themselves deep в my memories with agony as their brand.

Here awaits...
Flee from the cumulus.
There is no need to step в the crafted world.
